what: First verified launch of the flat Fallout 4 (Anniversary, 1.11.240) recipe. Game started through F4SE 0.7.9 from the portable MO2 instance and ran stably at the main menu with every recipe plugin loaded. devbench is dropped from this recipe, so this is log-based verification (the section 4b acceptance check), not an HTTP endpoint answer.

what_this_rules_out.addictol_1_5_2_load_screen_crash: gone — the GitHub 1.6.608.0 pin replaced the Nexus 1.5.2 that crashed at Fallout4.exe+099A595
what_this_rules_out.missing_masters: no Warnings.txt, so UFO4P / ppf.esm / prp.esp resolved
what_this_rules_out.ae_rewrites_plugins_txt: not observed — profile plugins.txt byte-identical before/after each run, in declared order
what_this_rules_out.steam_instability: earlier 'silent exits' were Steam being offline (LogonFailure No Connection); with Steam logged on, runs are clean

not_proven: a loaded save / new-game world (longest run is 86 s at the main menu; no save exists and flat FO4 has no headless launch path)
how_launched: Win32_Process.Create (WMI) so the game is parented to WmiPrvSE.exe, not the agent's process tree — see C:\Modding\mo2_fo4\launch-detached.ps1
plugin: none (log-based; devbench dropped from this recipe)
